text:
katie: Heads up, CI failed on docs PR #829 — mkdocs stopped on quickstart page with a YAML parse error and two images returning 404 after the CDN redirect. Anyone touching the Quickstart examples this morning?

docs-ci-bot: build failed: mkdocs build exit code 1
log excerpt: "while scanning a simple key" at docs/tutorials/quickstart.md:3

naveen: which PR/branch? I can take a look quickly.

katie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/829 (I moved demo images into /static/images and updated MDX snippets).

eli: we've seen the CDN strip trailing spaces during redirect normalization. If an image link has an accidental space, the deployed URL 404s. Also mkdocs YAML frontmatter is picky about tabs/indent.

sanjay: i'll try to repro locally with mkdocs and the same version the CI uses.

katie: top of quickstart.md from the failing build (copied from the PR):
```
---
title: Quickstart
permalink: /quickstart/
 tags: [quickstart]   # <-- leading-space mismatch (YAML parse error)
---
```

maria: that's odd, that looks like one space before tags instead of none. YAML requires matching indentation under the document start.

naveen: simple fix: remove the stray leading space. i'll open a tiny commit on the PR.

eli: while you're in there, search for image links with trailing spaces. `rg "!\[.*\]\(.*\s\)" -n docs | sed -n '1,40p'` found two occurrences in docs/tutorials/quickstart.md and docs/examples/auth.md.

sanjay: patched both occurrences locally and ran `mkdocs build --strict` — build passes, images resolve.

katie: can someone push the patch to the PR branch? i'll re-run the CI preview.

naveen: pushed commit: "docs(quickstart): fix frontmatter indent, trim trailing spaces from image links"

docs-ci-bot: CI: rebuild triggered for PR #829 (branch: fix/quickstart-yaml-image-cleanup)

docs-ci-bot: build succeeded, preview deployed -> https://deploy-preview-829.docs.redwood.com/tutorials/quickstart

maria: preview looks good in Chrome and Firefox; images load and no mkdocs warnings.

katie: thanks — can we add a quick pre-merge lint so this fails earlier? yamllint + a markdown-image checker that follows redirects would have caught the CDN issue.

naveen: i'll add a lightweight GH Action job: yamllint against `docs/**/*.md*` and a small script that validates image URLs (following redirects) return 200. will open PR after this merges.

eli: also propose a small docs dev guide note in CONTRIBUTING.md: "avoid trailing spaces in resource links" and add an editorconfig rule to strip trailing whitespace in markdown.

sanjay: opening issue #402: "docs: add yamllint and image-url smoke test to CI" with the scripts we used.

katie: perfect. merging once the follow-up yamllint job is in main. cheers everyone :tada:
